s1.quote: Depth: 4–30+ meters … Current: Calm … Sidem is located south of Batu Niti, just near Batu Belah temple … great for slow-paced macro exploration
Level: intermediate — a perfect progression dive Highlight: dense reef life in a manageable current

s2.quote: Pengah Kecil A compact, high-energy site with coral gardens, schooling fish, sharks and fast-changing visibility. Excellent when conditions align. Plateau / drift Max 30m

summary.text: A small three-pinnacle rock island in Komodo with walls, plateaus and sloping reef. Currents are manageable, making it a good step-up dive for intermediate divers; whitetip sharks rest under table corals.

s1.quote: This reef gently slopes down to 24 metres but there is plenty to see at around 10 metres

s2.quote: Sunset Reef … Depth 5–30 metres … Beginner to Advanced … mild to a low medium

s3.quote: This gradually sloping reef is suitable for all levels of diver

highlights.text: Hard and soft corals with snapper and sweetlips
Turtles; occasional manta at the cleaning station

summary.text: A gently sloping reef off the south-west of Gili Trawangan, suitable for all levels. Most of the interest lies around 10 m, with turtles, snapper and sweetlips, and the odd manta stopping at the cleaning station.

s1.quote: Toyapakeh Wall … Advanced … 5 – 30+ meters … Constant current, very deep towards the Toyapakeh Straight, the current runs along the wall

s2.quote: Toyapakeh … Multilevel slops 5m to 40m … Advanced to expert

highlights.text: Wall swept by current with abundant fish

summary.text: A current-swept wall on the Toyapakeh strait off Nusa Penida, rated advanced. The constant flow brings plenty of tropical fish, healthy hard and soft corals and, with luck, mola mola.

s1.quote: Eel Garden … 10 to 40+ meters … Moderate to strong … Advanced

s2.quote: Eel Garden … 4 to 30 m … approximately 40 meters … a large colony of dancing garden eels

s3.quote: Garden Eels … 5 to 35 m … garden eels, usually seen between 14 and 20 meters

highlights.text: Colony of garden eels on a sandy channel
Wall with schooling fish in the passing current

summary.text: At the western end of Menjangan, a reef wall drops from a shallow top to well beyond recreational depth, ending in a sandy channel with a colony of garden eels. Current can be moderate to strong.

s1.quote: Soraya Reef (Hidden Reef / Secret Reef / Mirko's) Depth: 12–30 metres Level: Advanced … known for its healthy coral formations, strong currents, and excellent fish life

highlights.text: Healthy coral, green turtles, schooling fish

s1.quote: Max Depth: 25 meters … Typical Current: Mild … An easy dive site that still has amazing coral and fish

s2.quote: Mioskun … 2m-25m … This site is well known as a likely opportunity to see Wobbegong Sharks

highlights.text: Soft-coral bommies and a giant clam

summary.text: A forgiving Dampier Strait reef with a sloping ridge, bommies smothered in soft coral and a mild current. Wobbegong sharks are the signature sighting, plus pygmy seahorses and a giant clam in the shallows.

s1.quote: Sampalan … 8 to 40 meters … probably, the richest corals in the area, schooling batfish, tuna, turtles

highlights.text: Rich corals, schooling batfish, tuna, turtles

s1.quote: Max Depth: 16 meters … Mild to Medium … best suited for beginners or experienced divers dependent on the day … Best For: Sit Back and Watch The Manta Show!

s2.quote: Manta Sandy … 2m-18m … Between the months of October and April, great numbers of Manta Rays congregate in the shallow

highlights.text: Turtles, blacktip sharks, Pegasus sea moth

summary.text: A shallow sandy-bottomed manta cleaning station near Mioskon in Raja Ampat. Black, reef and oceanic mantas queue up to be cleaned, most reliably October to April, in mild current.

s1.quote: Seahorse Bay … All levels … Typically a north to south current making the site perfect for drift diving … an amazing site for muck diving

s2.quote: Seahorse Bay … Keep an eye out for hairy frogfish, flamboyant cuttlefish, seahorses … an excellent dive for photographers

summary.text: A black-sand muck site on the Lombok side of the Gilis, good for macro photographers. Seahorses, hairy frogfish and flamboyant cuttlefish turn up, and it comes alive at dusk for night dives.

s1.quote: maximum depth of Tatawa Kecil is 30 meters … recommended only for experienced divers

s2.quote: Tatawa Kecil A more technical boulder-and-current site with valleys, swim-through potential and larger fish. Best reserved for divers comfortable with current management. Boulder / drift Max 30m

s3.quote: Level: very experienced divers only Current: strong to very strong — a specific tidal window is mandatory

highlights.text: Eagle rays, giant trevally and sharks

hazards.text: Very strong current; tidal window needed

summary.text: A rocky islet in the Linta Strait between Komodo and Rinca with swim-throughs, boulders and coral gardens. Current is strong to very strong, so it is for experienced divers timing the tide; sharks and rays patrol.

s1.quote: Pos II … 12 to 25 meters … Light to moderate … Intermediate

s2.quote: The wall starts at about 12m and extends down to 40m and then slopes off in to the blue

summary.text: A craggy wall on Menjangan starting at around 12 m and falling to about 40 m, with big gorgonian fans at 20-25 m. Light to moderate current; watch for territorial triggerfish.

s1.quote: The coral reef is not deep, sloping to around 30 meters … just 5 meters below the surface … Sometimes the current can be quite strong, which makes the site be dived regularly as a drift dive

highlights.text: Dense schools of fusiliers, snappers, surgeonfish
Sharks and pygmy seahorses in the fans

summary.text: A reef whose summit sits about 5 m down and slopes to roughly 30 m off Cape Kri, packed with fusiliers and snappers. Current can run strong, so it is often a drift; sharks and pygmy seahorses are regular.

s1.quote: Coral Garden … 5 to 20 meters … Light … Beginner

s2.quote: Coral Garden … 3 to 25 m … full of reef fish, big coral fans

s3.quote: a shallow dive site (5 to 12 meters)

highlights.text: Hard and soft coral, big fans, reef fish

summary.text: A shallow, calm coral garden on Menjangan, suitable for beginners and snorkellers. Hard and soft coral colonies, big fans and plenty of reef fish.

s1.quote: Max Depth: 30 meters Typical Current: Medium to Strong

highlights.text: Reef and oceanic mantas at cleaning stations

hazards.text: Strong current may need reef hooking

summary.text: A pelagic hotspot off Mansuar: a reef top at 7-8 m sloping to 25-30 m. Mantas visit cleaning stations and sharks, tuna and trevally pass through. Current is medium to strong.

s1.quote: depths ranging from 10 to 27meters … The currents here are moderate to strong … intermediate to advanced divers

s2.quote: This large pinnacle is found around 14m in-depth

highlights.text: Soft corals in orange and yellow hues

hazards.text: Intense current: do not swim into it

summary.text: A pinnacle and ridge in Raja Ampat plastered in soft coral, with schools of bumphead parrotfish, barracuda and fusiliers. Currents are moderate to strong and the dive direction follows the flow.

s1.quote: Seraya Secret … Depth: 4–40 meters … Calm to mild current

s2.quote: Seraya Secrets … 3–40 m … World famous macro dive site for photographers

summary.text: A world-famous black-sand macro slope on the Tulamben coast, with artificial structures in the shallows and sponge and coral further down. Calm to mild current; frogfish, harlequin shrimp and ghost pipefish.

s1.quote: Emerald … Depth: 5–30+ meters … Calm to moderate … The dive begins in a shallow bay with a sandy white bottom

s2.quote: At around 20-30m depth, the reef becomes richer with a large number of sponges

highlights.text: Gorgonian fans, eel gardens, reef sharks

summary.text: A quiet Tulamben boat or jukung dive starting in a sandy bay with artificial structures, then a drop-off where sponges and gorgonian fans get richer from about 20-30 m. Reef sharks are a good sighting.

s1.quote: Simon's Reef Depth: 14–25 metres Level: Advanced … Simon's Reef at a glance Maximum depth 30 meters Typical visibility 20-30 meters Current strength mild to strong

s2.quote: rises from a sandy bottom at a depth of 35m … The average depth for this dive site is around 25m

s3.quote: the best deep dive sites for recreational divers (30m)

summary.text: A deep mid-channel site north of the Gilis with canyons and large bommies rising from sand. Channel currents funnel in schooling fish, reef sharks and turtles; suited to advanced divers.

s1.quote: Air Wall … 5–25 metres … Beginner to Advanced … mild to strong

s2.quote: As the slope evens out at around 18 meters

highlights.text: Wall covered in corals and sponges

summary.text: A sloping reef off Gili Air that steepens into a wall around 18 m, covered in coral and sponges. Turtles are frequent and conditions are usually manageable.

s1.quote: Napoleon Reef … 3 to 25 m … Discover the wonderful corals in its shallow area and a deep pinnacle adorned with gorgonian fans

s2.quote: The deep end of Napoleon Reef offers the usual and unusual fish from Close Encounters, plus rays and cuttlefish are a regular sighting

highlights.text: Rays and cuttlefish on the deep end
